scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,app -c cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:web" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && pnpm dev:app"
scripts.check: pnpm --filter web check && pnpm --filter app check
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter web lint:fix && pnpm --filter app lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter app typecheck
scripts.format: pnpm --filter web format && pnpm --filter app format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter web format:check && pnpm --filter app format:check
